Sasha —

Thanks again for the session yesterday. Per our onboarding acceptance criteria I wanted to confirm the plan for the final load verification run and what artifacts we'll collect so your procurement and engineering teams have everything for go/no-go. High level: we need a baseline run that exercises your peak burst (210 rps sustained for 10 minutes), a longer ramp run to validate sustained throughput (120 rps for 60 minutes), and three cold-start samples to measure KV-cache warmup impact.

Please confirm we have a stable test account (api key + tenant) and whether your test traffic will traverse the sandbox VPC or your staging VPC. Items we'll deliver back to you:
- p50/p95/p99 latency distributions (generation and total)
- sustained throughput graphs and 1-minute buckets
- error rates and 5xx breakdowns
- exact load driver config we used (burst profile + seed)

I've attached the burst_profile config we'll use and a short checklist. If that looks good, we'll run Thursday morning PDT and share raw CSVs + summary.

Next actions: please reply with the test account details and a procurement contact for the final signoff doc.

Thanks,
Marcus
Director, Customer Success

Subject: Load run results and artifacts (raw CSV attached)

Folks —

We ran the sequence this morning (09:05–11:20 PDT) against tenant alvion-staging-43 over the staging VPC. Summary below — raw data is in the attached CSV and the dashboards link. Highlights:

Run A: 10-minute peak burst (target 210 rps)
- Observed peak sustained: 208 rps (1-min buckets)
- p50 latency (gen): 90 ms; p95: 340 ms; p99: 880 ms
- 5xx rate: 0.12% (10 of 8,320 requests) — all tied to a short downstream DB connection reset at 09:38 (we retried and then passed)

Run B: 60-minute sustained (target 120 rps)
- Observed sustained: 122 rps average
- p50: 82 ms; p95: 290 ms; p99: 610 ms
- Error rate: 0.04% (3 of 18,150 requests)

Cold-start samples (three runs)
- First request median cold-start latency: 1.9 s (includes model KV warmup)
- By the 6th token, KV cache hit improves generation p95 by ~45%

Notes and next steps:
- We captured full traces for the two 5xx incidents and uploaded logs to the shared drive (link below). One incident is an upstream DB transient; we recommend the customer confirm DB connection pool sizing for staging/prod parity.
- We included the exact load driver seed and burst_profile we used (attached) so results are reproducible.
- We'll produce the condensed Acceptance Evidence PDF by tomorrow at 11:00 PDT and circulate for signoff.

Attachments: load_test_results_20270427.csv (1.8 MB)
Dashboards: https://redwood.share/drive/alvion-load-dashboards

-Dylan
SRE, Redwood Inference
